liebermann.notes: Parchment manuscript; after poems of Henry of Huntingdon comes the Tripartita, i.e. Wl art, ECf retr and the Genealogia Normannica. Described by Wanley as belonging to the ancestor (Weymouth).

entries.text_de: Marquess of Bath11, 14. Jh., Pergament. Hinter Gedichten Heinrichs von Huntingdon: Tripartita, d. i. Wl art (u. S. 486), ECf retr (u. S. 627) und Geneal. Normannica12.
entries.text_en: Marquess of Bath11, 14th century, parchment. After poems of Henry of Huntingdon: Tripartita, i.e. Wl art (below, p. 486), ECf retr (below, p. 627) and the Geneal. Normannica12.

notes.text_de: Beschrieben im Third report of histor. mss. p. 189 und, als dem Ahnen (Weymouth) gehörig, von Wanley Catal. libr. (Hickes Thes. ling. sept. III) 284.
notes.text_en: Described in the Third report of histor. mss. p. 189 and, as belonging to the ancestor (Weymouth), by Wanley, Catal. libr. (Hickes, Thes. ling. sept. III) 284.
